findings.evidence: EVID-084 through EVID-094 metrics contain duration_ms and verification only; none contains context, tools, or usage.status=unavailable with null token/cost. The default verification-profile path also creates only selection metrics when no metrics input is supplied.
findings.recommendation: Add current source-bound evidence containing bounded context/tool metrics and explicit unavailable/null usage, or narrow the acceptance claim and record the residual limitation.
findings.title: specification: AC-008 current evidence omits context/tool and explicit unavailable usage

findings.evidence: baseline/quality.md states that numeric metrics must be finite, non-negative, and no greater than 10,000,000. normalize_evidence_metrics applies that ceiling to integer counters and tokens, but usage.cost only checks finiteness and non-negativity.
findings.recommendation: Apply the documented ceiling to usage.cost, or document a separate bounded cost policy and add a regression.
findings.title: standards: usage.cost is outside the documented metric ceiling

findings.evidence: snapshot.ts applies a per-file default read limit to artifacts and evidence JSON, but evidence-file count and aggregate artifact/evidence bytes are unbounded. VscodeFileSystemPort reads the full file before slicing to maxBytes, so the production read is not I/O-bounded.
findings.recommendation: Enforce explicit aggregate count/byte budgets and bounded reads during I/O, with a large-detail regression.
findings.title: specification: AC-003 has no aggregate detail-read bound

findings.evidence: parseFrontmatter and parseWikiPage only diagnose a missing block or missing title/type/status. A non-array sources value becomes an empty array, and wrong-typed fingerprint fields are discarded without parseErrors, contrary to the unsupported-frontmatter diagnostic requirement.
findings.recommendation: Validate supported frontmatter types, emit parse diagnostics, and add a regression proving malformed fields cannot appear as a clean projection.
findings.title: specification: AC-004 silently drops unsupported frontmatter types

findings.evidence: EVID-090 is passed but reports one Windows symlink-privilege skip; acceptance.md records that complete symlink coverage requires a privileged rerun. Therefore the accepted evidence does not execute every stated symlink adapter case.
findings.recommendation: Run the same high-profile verification with symlink privilege, or keep AC-001 explicitly bounded by this documented residual limitation.
findings.title: standards: AC-001 symlink coverage is unavailable in the accepted run

summary: 整體通過，未發現 critical security、data-loss、irreversible 或 scope 問題；但有五項 specification/standards advisory。AC-013 的歷史 baseline 限制已正確記錄，未另行要求未支持的百分比。
